note:
DTN Content Services cash-bids-table-widget. Read from ONE call to https://api.dtn.com/markets/sites/e0030901/cash-bids?units=us — the site id e0030901 carries this location and its neighbours together, so every one of them is a source file and none of them is new code. IT IS READ THROUGH A BROWSER AND NOT BY A FETCH: DTN answered a server-side probe with "The api key is valid, but it is valid to be used within a browser only", so their gateway scopes these widget keys to browser use. poll.mjs loads https://fscooperatives.com/aglandfs/agriculture/cash-bids in a real Chromium and reads the response their own widget asks for, which means we hold no key at all — theirs is public in their page, as it must be for the widget to work. THE LOCATION KEY IS THE NUMERIC location.id (4205) AND NOT THE NAME: a display name is exactly the thing a vendor re-cases, and some of these names are companies rather than towns. cashRounding is DELIBERATELY ABSENT. One run said floor-cent (3 testable rows, margin 3) and there is no second run to agree with it. A mode is a property of how they compute their board, so it needs the same answer on a different day's prices. Left off, the identity guard stays exact and a board that does not reconcile refuses loudly instead of publishing under a mode nobody established. COORDINATES ARE NULL AND THAT IS DELIBERATE: the feed carries no coordinate, and a town centroid is a different place from a yard — measured at 1.4 miles on babgrain-auburn. Geocode the street address before relying on a map pin. Built by scripts/dtn-build.mjs from a dtn-probe log; 3 row(s) for this location. Supplied by Sig on 2026-08-25 from the operator's own location directory. Ag-Land FS's own grain terminal page lists Elmwood, Green Valley, Williamsfield and Monica-Dunlap and does not name Alto, which is why it was held back rather than guessed. ROUNDING MEASURED 2026-08-26, not guessed: every failing row on this board sits a POSITIVE fraction of a cent from the arithmetic (residuals 0 and +0.75c only, never negative), which is cash truncated to the cent in the buyer's favour. That is the DTN Content Services signature already measured 25 of 25 at Ag Partners and already declared on this operator's sibling locations. floor-cent is DIRECTIONAL and BOUNDED, so it is strictly stronger than the cashRoundingCents tolerance it replaces: a board reading a cent HIGH still refuses, and so does every column shift, which moves things by tens of cents.

LOCATED (2026-10-09): "Alto" on Ag-Land FS's board is read as the Alto Ingredients plant at Pekin, IL, by name match: data/known-elevators.json (and geocodes/places.json known["3096"]) has the Barchart row for Alto Ingredients, Inc. at Pekin, IL 61554 (1300 South Second Street), and two other operators' Barchart rows name the same delivery point there -- Western Grain Marketing - FS, branch "ALTO/ICP Pekin", Pekin, IL 61554, and (in agsist data/elevator-directory.json) River Valley Cooperative, branch "ALTO ICP", Pekin, IL 61554. No other "Alto" in Illinois appears in any repository table, the board quotes corn only (an ethanol plant buys corn), and Ag-Land FS's licensed yards in data/registries.json (Bartonville, Canton, Dunlap, Elmwood, Green Valley, Monica, Williamsfield) are in the Peoria/Tazewell area around Pekin. Only the ZIP is set: Alto runs more than one plant in Pekin, so neither a street nor a coordinate is taken. This is a delivered bid at a buyer's plant, not an Ag-Land FS yard.
publicNote: Their publicly posted cash board, read from the feed their own website reads. Cash and basis are their own commercial numbers. The futures quote is carried only so a consumer can re-check cash minus basis; it is not redistributed as a price feed.
